title: Chiropractor: NPPES practice identity with public business-contact safeguard
hypothesis: An active NPPES NPI-2 record with primary taxonomy Chiropractor can identify a chiropractic practice and an Authorized Official candidate. Its published LOCATION phone can start a business-contact workflow, but neither an Authorized Official nor an AO phone establishes ownership, handset ownership, or a private-contact right.
ownerSource: NPPES NPI-2 Authorized Official fields provide an identity and role candidate for an active primary-taxonomy chiropractic organization. The role is not owner confirmation and needs independent corroboration.
phoneSource: Use only the NPPES LOCATION telephone as a proposed published practice-contact candidate. Do not promote the Authorized Official telephone to an owner phone, and do not discover a number from mailing/licence/property addresses, parcel matching, skip tracing, or appends.

workflow.label: NPPES chiropractic organization
workflow.detail: Read an active NPI-2 record whose primary taxonomy is Chiropractor and retain practice identity plus Authorized Official role candidate.

workflow.label: Active primary-taxonomy check
workflow.detail: Require active status, primary Chiropractic taxonomy, and a person-form Authorized Official; exclude explicit staff titles.

workflow.label: Hold invalid or staff record
workflow.detail: Inactive, taxonomy-mismatched, personless, and credentialing/billing/office-management records cannot support an owner candidate.

workflow.label: Published LOCATION phone?
workflow.detail: Use an explicitly published NPPES LOCATION telephone only as a practice business-contact candidate; AO phone is not a substitute.

workflow.label: Hold without public business contact
workflow.detail: Keep identity evidence only. Do not parcel-match, trace, append, or derive a private number from any address.

workflow.label: Business-contact gates
workflow.detail: Apply permitted line-type, live, DNC/TCPA, suppression, duplicate, and freshness checks to the published practice contact.

workflow.label: Independent owner and handset evidence?
workflow.detail: Require corroborated ownership and an explicit direct-business-role link to the same contact; AO title or a practice line alone fails this test.

workflow.label: Hold as business contact
workflow.detail: Retain the permitted practice-contact classification without an owner-confirmed or owner-mobile label.

workflow.label: Deliver supported contact
workflow.detail: Deliver only after all applicable contact gates and independent ownership/handset evidence support the stated classification.

edges.label: independent owner and handset evidence supports classification

failures.risk: An Authorized Official is treated as the current practice owner.
failures.mitigation: Keep AO identity and role as a candidate only; require independent current ownership evidence.

failures.risk: An AO phone is treated as a personal owner handset or as the published practice contact.
failures.mitigation: Use only NPPES LOCATION phone for the proposed business-contact route and require separate owner/handset evidence.

failures.risk: A chiropractic row without AO phone enters residential parcel lookup and paid skip tracing through recipe B.
failures.mitigation: Hold chiropractor recipe-B jobs before parcel and trace, then use a LOCATION-phone-only public-business-contact route.

failures.risk: Corporate, repeated-AO, or franchise records are called independent owner contacts.
failures.mitigation: Screen corporate/repeated-AO evidence and require independent owner corroboration before owner-confirmed classification.

failures.risk: A published practice line is labelled a direct owner mobile.
failures.mitigation: Retain a business-contact classification unless independent evidence explicitly links the same contact to an owner/founder business role.

sources.label: NPPES NPI-2 chiropractic adapter
sources.scope: Active NPI-2 Chiropractic organization query by state/ZIP prefix; primary-taxonomy, AO identity, AO telephone, and LOCATION telephone parsing.

sources.label: Live chiropractor brain mapping
sources.scope: Chiropractor currently maps to recipe B and nppes:chiropractor, which can continue into parcel and paid trace processing.

sources.label: NPPES public practice-contact route
sources.scope: Active primary-taxonomy chiropractic rows with a published LOCATION telephone only; no private-number discovery.

sources.label: Owner-evidence assessment
sources.scope: Current business-site direct-contact evidence plus independent registry owner/founder corroboration.

iterations.hypothesis: The mapped NPPES chiropractic source can safely support recipe-B owner-contact processing.
iterations.test: Five synthetic NPI-2 inputs were passed to nppesOrganization(item, 'Chiropractor') on 2026-09-24: active Owner title with no AO phone; active Owner title with AO phone; inactive; Credentialing Manager; and active Dentist taxonomy.
iterations.observed: The two active Chiropractic Owner cases were kept; the no-AO-phone case had phone10 null, the AO-phone case used AO phone10, inactive was status_not_active, staff was staff_title_excluded, and Dentist was primary_taxonomy_mismatch. Recipe B sends no-phone rows toward parcel and trace. This is local parser/routing evidence only.
iterations.change: Hold chiropractor recipe-B work before private parcel/trace steps. Implement a public-business-contact route that uses only NPPES LOCATION phone and preserves AO evidence as non-owner identity evidence.

measurement.result: Five synthetic NPPES NPI-2 parser cases: two active primary-Chiropractor owner-title rows kept (one no AO phone, one AO phone); inactive, explicit credentialing staff, and primary-Dentist cases rejected. The audit measured parser behavior only; no network, contact values, phone verification, ownership, reachability, DNC, or delivery measurement occurred.

cost.basis: Local five-case parser audit; proposed NPPES public directory identity/contact source is free
cost.note: No clean contact or contact-gate outcome was measured. Historical recipe-B expectations and research estimates use different denominators and do not establish a chiropractor per-clean cost.

implementation.summary: The NPPES adapter correctly rejects inactive, taxonomy-mismatched, and explicit staff-title rows, but the live chiropractor recipe-B mapping can use private parcel and paid trace processing. LOCATION phone is parsed only into payload while AO phone becomes phone10; no chiropractor public-business-contact-only route or owner-evidence delivery gate is wired.

nextMeasurement: After the public-contact correction, run five synthetic route cases—LOCATION-only, AO-only, both-different, no phone, and credentialing title—and assert only LOCATION phone enters business-contact gates, AO-only/no-phone rows hold, staff rejects, and no parcel or trace call is possible. Then run a lawful aggregate 5-20 row public NPPES observation with separate active, taxonomy-qualified, LOCATION-phone, corporate-held, contact-gate, independently owner-supported, and delivered-business-contact denominators.
